about.title: Meet G:URL*s
about.description: We're a coding club for the FLINTA* community, open to anyone interested in learning or improving their programming skills. Whether you're just starting out or already experienced, you'll find a supportive space to connect, ask questions, and grow at your own pace!

standFor.title: What We Stand For
standFor.subtitle: The name G:URL*s reflects what matters to us:

redefining.title: Redefining
redefining.description: Challenging norms and reshaping tech culture

solving.title: Solving
solving.description: Using code to make impact and tackle challenges together

whatWeDo.title: What We Do
whatWeDo.description: We host events in English during the semester that range from beginner-friendly workshops, practical coding sessions, and tech talks to social events and co-working evenings. Some events focus on learning new tools or building projects, while others are simply about connecting with others in tech.
whatWeDo.footer: You're welcome to join as often as you like, no need to prep or commit to anything long-term!

whoCanJoin.title: Who Can Join
whoCanJoin.description: If you identify as FLINTA* and have an interest in tech, you're welcome to join, no matter your background, experience, or education. You don't need to be an expert, just curious and open to learning. We're a space for beginners, career changers, hobbyists, and anyone who wants to explore tech in a supportive environment.
whoCanJoin.flintaExplanation: FLINTA* stands for Female, Lesbian, Intersex, Non-binary, Trans, Agender, and other non-binary gender identities.

team.title: Meet the Team
team.description: Meet the volunteer crew of developers, designers and organizers behind G:URL*s Coding Club in Vienna.
team.heading: The humans behind G:URL*s
team.subtitle: A community of FLINTA*s from all walks of life, united by a passion for IT and a drive to make the tech world more inclusive.
team.whoWeAreText: The G:URL*s coding club was started by a group of FLINTA*s with diverse backgrounds and a passion for IT. Even though our club and our team is growing, our dedication to diversity is still strong. Although we come from a variety of national and ethnic backgrounds as well as fields of study and professions, we are united by our passion to expose more FLINTA* people to the world of IT and programming, while creating a community to facilitate growth in a supportive environment. We are grateful to everyone who wants to be a part of this journey with us.
team.calloutEyebrow: A lot of people ask us
team.calloutQuestion: Do I need to be a student to join this club?
team.signUpText: We want to unite all FLINTA* people at different points in their lives. Not even all our team members are students: we work in many different IT fields and want to continue to expand our pool of members. If you are interested in becoming a part of the club or joining our organisational team, sign up below.

members.emily: Passionate about bioinformatics and investigating biological questions with code using R and Python. In her free time you can find her running or hiking and exploring the Austrian countryside.
members.lara: Software developer building C# applications for train production. Loves organising events, inline skating, gaming, and meeting new people. Fun fact: invite her over and she'll show up with a home-made cake!
members.laura: Organises projects and events and leads workshops. If you ever see her working, you'll notice she needs at least 3–4 different drinks to keep up concentration.
members.julia: Responsible for strategy and partner relationship management. Works in IT consulting, supporting companies in their digital transformation. Motivated to make the tech industry a more inclusive and diverse space.
members.pierre: Currently studying molecular biology and working in sales. Fun fact: "I can tell the manufacturer of a roller coaster by the look of the tracks."
members.bibi: Software Engineer at Vendure. Passionate about bouldering, board games, and making change in the tech industry. Fun fact: can do a pull-up.
members.andreea: Passionate about telecommunications, working as a Software Engineer at a small telco company. In her free time she likes playing tennis, reading, and doing all kinds of DIY things.
members.anja: Holds a Master's in Cognitive Science and puts her passion for understanding people to work on the club's HR team. Fun fact: despite studying the human mind, her brain refuses to function without coffee first.
members.marjan: Has a master's degree in computer engineering and works in an IT company. In her free time, she enjoys content creation, photography, and discovering new music while enjoying a cup of tea.
members.anna: Currently doing her PhD in Theoretical Biology, where she tries to understand evolutionary processes through statistical analyses in R. Outside of research, you'll likely find her doing sports or watching horror movies.
